# dotdog — The Spec Dog

A CLI tool and file format for structured, AI-queryable software specifications.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g dotdog
```

## Commands

- `dotdog validate` — Score your spec completeness
- `dotdog parse` — Parse .dog files to AST
- `dotdog compile` — Compile .dog to .dag graph
- `dotdog generate` — Generate missing spec files
- `dotdog serve` — MCP server for AI agents
- `dotdog staleness` — Detect spec/reality drift
- `dotdog visualize` — Mermaid graph from .dag

## Format

- `.dog` — Human-written spec (markdown + YAML entities). Open source.
- `.dag` — Machine-compiled graph (JSON). Token-efficient for AI agents.

- GitHub: https://github.com/specdog/dotdog
